newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand raises tapioca export projection.
newsitem.headline: Thailand raises tapioca export projection.

text.p: Thailand raised its 1997 tapioca export projection to 4.8 million tonnes from about 4.0 million estimated in December, the commerce ministry said on Thursday.

A ministry statement said although 1997 exports are expected to increase 10 percent from last year, Thailand will likely fetch 18 billion baht ($692 million) in foreign exchange, a four percent decline from 1996 due to weak tapioca prices.

The ministry attributed the higher export forecast to projected bigger domestic output. But tapioca prices will be depressed by softer feed grain prices in the European Union, Thailand's biggest tapioca market.
It said Japan and Taiwan would be two other major markets for Thai tapioca this year.
Thai Commerce Minister Narongchai Akrasanee had forecast in December that 1997 exports would reach only four million tonnes.
